label: SYNTHETIC DATA / SIMULATED OPERATION / OFFLINE EVALUATION / NOT PRODUCTION DEPLOYED.
owner_decision: Retry and fallback are NOT a universal default. Every operation has exactly one explicit class; the default for an unclassified operation is DO_NOT_RETRY and HUMAN_REVIEW (fail closed).

operation_classes.SAFE_TO_RETRY: No side effects. Repeating the call cannot change state. Retry with exponential backoff, jitter and a retry limit.
operation_classes.SAFE_WITH_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY: Has side effects, but the target deduplicates on a caller-supplied key. Retry only with the same key; without a key, dead-letter.
operation_classes.RECONCILE_BEFORE_RETRY: Has side effects and no key. After an ambiguous failure, first READ whether the effect happened; retry only if it did not, and treat 'found' as success.
operation_classes.DO_NOT_RETRY: Has side effects, cannot be reconciled from state alone (or must never run). Never retried; ambiguous failures are dead-lettered for a person.
operation_classes.HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED: A person decides every failure. Nothing is retried or replayed automatically.

failure_classes.TRANSIENT: Temporary upstream or infrastructure error (UPSTREAM_FAILURE, RETRIEVER_ERROR). May succeed on repeat.
failure_classes.TIMEOUT_AMBIGUOUS: Timeout of an operation that may have committed a side effect before the response was lost. State unknown.
failure_classes.RATE_LIMIT: Explicit throttling (429, RATE_LIMITED). The call was refused; wait at least Retry-After.
failure_classes.DEPENDENCY_DOWN: The dependency is known down or its circuit breaker is open (CIRCUIT_OPEN, MODEL_UNAVAILABLE). Do not hammer it.
failure_classes.VALIDATION: The input or a business rule was rejected (INVALID_ARGUMENTS, REJECTED). Permanent for these inputs.
failure_classes.AUTH: Authentication, approval, taint or permission refusal (APPROVAL_REQUIRED, TAINTED_ARGUMENT, FORBIDDEN_EXTERNAL_ACTION, UNKNOWN_TOOL, AUTH_*). A control working as designed; never retried.
failure_classes.PERMANENT: Will not succeed on repeat (NOT_FOUND, anything not recognised and free of side effects).
failure_classes.MALFORMED_RESULT: The call returned something that violates its schema (MALFORMED_RESULT, SCHEMA_VIOLATION). For a write the effect may have happened.

actions.RETRY: Retry after exponential backoff with jitter, up to max_attempts and within the retry budget.
actions.RECONCILE_THEN_RETRY: Read whether the side effect happened. Found: return it as the result. Absent: retry (as RETRY). Unknown: dead-letter.
actions.FAIL_FAST: Stop at once and surface the failure (the agent turns it into a gap and an escalation).
actions.DEAD_LETTER: Stop, persist a dead-letter record with replay instructions and put it in the human queue.

unknown_code_rule: an unrecognised error code is TIMEOUT_AMBIGUOUS when the operation has side effects (state unknown) and PERMANENT otherwise; it is never classified as retryable-by-default
decision_guards: SAFE_WITH_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY: RETRY needs an idempotency key; without one the decision becomes DEAD_LETTER
RECONCILE_THEN_RETRY needs a reconciler; without one the decision becomes DEAD_LETTER (the effect cannot be verified)
RETRY / RECONCILE_THEN_RETRY past max_attempts: operations with side effects -> DEAD_LETTER when the last failure left the state unknown, otherwise FAIL_FAST
an exhausted retry budget turns RETRY into FAIL_FAST (no side effects) or DEAD_LETTER (side effects)
a malformed result is retried for an operation only if the operation sets retry_malformed (the LLM planner)

retry_budget.note: retries may add at most 20 percent on top of first attempts, plus a floor of 3, per budget window; this stops a degraded dependency from being amplified into a retry storm

llm_planner_call.rationale: generation is a pure function of the prompt; a repeat costs tokens and latency but changes no state. Malformed (schema-violating) model output is stochastic and is retried; bounded because every retry costs money and a persistently invalid model must escalate. MODEL_UNAVAILABLE is a down dependency: fail fast, escalate

knowledge_retrieval.rationale: read-only retrieval; after the bounded retry the lexical fallback answers through the same status-aware code

http_upstream_get.rationale: idempotent read (HTTP GET semantics); honours Retry-After on rate limits

http_upstream_post_with_idempotency_key.rationale: a write is retried only with the SAME caller-generated key and only against an upstream that deduplicates on it. Without a key it is dead-lettered, not retried

http_upstream_post_unkeyed.rationale: a non-idempotent write to an upstream that cannot deduplicate: a lost response is ambiguous, so a second POST can double-apply

agent_run_start.rationale: AgentService.start is deduplicated by event_id (a re-delivered event is ignored as DUPLICATE_IGNORED); the event id is the idempotency key. A crashed run left RUNNING must first be marked FAILED (OpsService does) or the retry is ignored (FC-15)

ops_store_write.rationale: the ops store keys rows by run_id / dead-letter id with INSERT OR REPLACE-style writes, so replaying the same write converges to one row

db_write_unkeyed.rationale: INSERT into the simulation database with a generated primary key: a retry after an ambiguous failure can create a second row

human_approval_execute_step.rationale: the approval -> execute step applies an approved mutation. Any failure here leaves state a person must inspect (what executed, what did not); nothing is automatically replayed, and an expired or forged approval is re-opened by a person, never worked around

query_inventory.rationale: pure SELECTs over the simulation database

search_nasha_knowledge.rationale: read-only retrieval; a retriever outage is also covered by the lexical fallback (resilience.ResilientKB)

get_current_policy.rationale: read-only retrieval and answer; an abstention is a valid result, not a failure, and is never retried

get_supplier_notes_untrusted.rationale: read-only call through the trust gateway to an UNTRUSTED upstream; retrying never changes state, and the result is re-validated every time

draft_purchase_recommendation.rationale: INSERT with a random draft id and no idempotency key: a timeout after the commit is indistinguishable from a failure before it. Reconcile by (run, kind, exact payload) first. A blind retry duplicated the draft in 10 of 10 trials (GAP-01)

draft_review_ticket.rationale: same mechanism as the purchase draft (random id, no key); reconcile by (run, kind, exact payload)

adjust_inventory_record.rationale: append-only INSERT of a stock delta bound to a single-use approval; two identical adjustments are legitimate, so state alone cannot prove whether a lost response committed. A human checks the movements table

flag_record_for_review.rationale: INSERT into the human review queue under an approval bound to these exact arguments; ambiguity after a timeout goes to a person, not to a second attempt

release_draft.rationale: state transition DRAFT_NOT_SUBMITTED -> APPROVED_FOR_HUMAN_PROCUREMENT_REVIEW; the target status is directly observable, so reconcile by reading the draft status. Only ever runs under an approval; the executor never retries without reading the status first

contact_supplier.rationale: FORBIDDEN in this prototype: never executed, never retried; every attempt is refused and logged

place_purchase_order.rationale: FORBIDDEN in this prototype: never executed, never retried; every attempt is refused and logged
